title: Vector of the generator
description: A test vector of the generator (section 22 of the format text): the start of a stream — two words, and the seed and names of the place of randomness whose stream it is — and the functions called on the stream, in order, each with its arguments and the value it gives.

seed.description: The seed of the place of randomness whose stream this is. With it come its names, and the state is the one they derive.

names.description: The names of the place of randomness, in order: each a string that is not empty and holds no |.

high.description: The high word of the state that starts the stream.

low.description: The low word of the state that starts the stream.

state.description: The two words that start the stream, as the generator takes them: those that the seed and the names derive, when they are given.

draws.description: The functions called on the stream, in order, each with its arguments and the value it gives.

unsigned.description: An unsigned integer of 64 bits, from 0 to 18446744073709551615, in decimal digits with no leading zero: a YAML number holds an integer of 53 bits at most.

signed.description: A signed integer of 64 bits, from -9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807, in decimal digits with no leading zero.

integer.description: The next integer of the stream.

value.description: The integer, from 0 to the bound less one.

from.description: The least integer it may give.

to.description: The greatest integer it may give.

between.description: An integer between two, both included.

value.description: The number: a multiple of 2^-53, which a double holds exactly and which a reader compares as a double.

fraction.description: A number from 0 up to 1, never 1.

value.description: The integers from 0 to the count less one, in the order it gives.

permutation.description: An order of the integers from 0 up to a count.

draw.description: A function called on the stream, by its one field, with its arguments and the value it gives.
